title: I wanted to create an addictive educational game about world history, but somehow it turned into this:
author: Few_Paramedic_8561
selftext:
For quite a long time, I’ve been developing a game where you can live the life of an ordinary person in any historical era.  
I came up with an interesting random character generation mechanic based on a slot machine, wrote storylines, filled the game with historical events and stories.  
Then I hit a problem: the gameplay started getting boring too quickly.  
So I added childhood mini-games, prophetic dreams throughout your life that can boost your stats if you remember things from your school education, and even gambling mechanics where you can literally lose your house and family.  
But somehow, I still feel like I haven’t found that one special ingredient that makes people want to play with genuine excitement and get completely hooked.  
I’ve already managed to attract almost 975 players, and I’m actively testing and improving the game.  
What would you recommend? What do you think could make this game truly addictive and engaging?  
You can try it here:  
https://thousands.life/
